name: repository-harness
description: Harness validation manifest. Each top-level entry is either a check add-on (description + severity + failure message templates + target paths/data) or metadata (description + data, no severity, not validated). validator는 이 manifest를 single source of truth로 사용한다. harness는 versioning하지 않으므로 schemaVersion / deprecated / legacy 키는 존재하지 않는다.

requireFilesExist.description: Every path listed in `paths` MUST exist as a regular file under the target repository root. Used to enforce the canonical harness contract files.

requireDirectoriesExist.description: Every path listed in `paths` MUST exist as a directory under the target repository root.

requireKeepfileInEmptyDirectories.description: Each directory under `directories` MUST contain at least one real file or a `.gitkeep` placeholder. Empty directories are tolerated only when `.gitkeep` is present.
requireKeepfileInEmptyDirectories.failureMessageTemplate: empty directory must keep placeholder or real files: {directory}

requireTemplateGroups.description: Each group listed in `groups` MUST exist as a directory under `targetRoot`.

requireDocHeadings.description: Each authored `.md` file derived from `sourceFilesFromCategory.paths` and matching `sourceFilter` MUST contain every heading listed in `headings`.

requireDocContent.description: For each entry in `checks`, the concatenation of `files` content (joined with newlines) MUST contain every substring in `containsAll`. The entry's `failureMessage` is emitted otherwise.

checks.failureMessage: root contract (CLAUDE.md, aliased as AGENTS.md) must contain Repository Harness Contract
root contract must contain an Entry Point section
root contract must reference AGENTS.md so both filenames resolve to the same document
root contract must describe docs/generated/ semantics
repository docs must describe generated-artifact source command and regeneration trigger metadata
root contract must state that the harness may evolve across development phases

requireAgentFrontmatter.description: Every `.md` file directly under `directory` MUST start with `frontmatterStart` and contain every field listed in `requiredFields`. The `name` value MUST match `namePattern`.

failureMessages.missingDirectory: .claude/agents must contain at least one .md agent

requireSkillFrontmatter.description: Every file named `filename` under `rootDirectory` (any depth) MUST start with `frontmatterStart` and contain every field listed in `requiredFields`.

failureMessages.missingDirectory: .claude/skills must contain at least one SKILL.md

forbidScaffoldLeaks.description: Scan every file under `scope.bases` (excluding `scope.excludedSubtrees` and files whose extension is not in `scope.extensions`) and emit a finding for every regex match in `patterns`. Catches unresolved template tokens, scaffold prompts, TODO markers, or stack placeholders that leaked into active assets.

requireHookShebang.description: Each hook listed in `hooks` MUST start with the line in `expectedShebang`.

requireHookExecutable.description: Each hook listed in `hooks` MUST have its executable bit set on disk.

requireHookGeneratedMarker.description: Each hook listed in `hooks` MUST contain the line `markerTemplate` (with `{name}` substituted to the hook filename) and MUST NOT contain `placeholderForbidden`.
requireHookGeneratedMarker.placeholderForbidden: packaged placeholder is replaced during harness installation

requireHookStage.description: Each hook MUST contain `markerTemplate` with `{stage}` substituted from `stages[<stack>][<hookName>]`. The active stack identifier is supplied by the validator at runtime.
requireHookStage.failureMessageTemplate: {hook} must contain stage marker '# Harness stage: {expectedStage}'

requireHookCommand.description: `prePushHook` MUST declare (in a `# Harness validation command:` comment) and actually run a command listed in `allowedCommands[<stack>]`. When `allowedPreCommitCommands[<stack>]` is non-empty, `preCommitHook` MUST also declare and run one of those commands; otherwise pre-commit MUST NOT run any full-stack validation command.

failureMessages.commandNotRun: {hook} must run the declared validation command
failureMessages.preCommitMustNotRunFullStack: pre-commit hook must not run full stack validation commands

requireCiCommandMatchesHook.description: Each file listed in `ciFiles` that exists on disk MUST contain the validation command declared by `referenceHook`. Files that are intentionally absent for the active CI host are skipped without warning.

requireEnvShebangUnder.description: Any executable script under any directory listed in `directories` whose first line starts with `#!` MUST start with `expectedPrefix`. Used to enforce portable `/usr/bin/env <interpreter>` shebangs.

forbidUncheckedTasksUnder.description: Every file matching `filenamePattern` under `directory` MUST NOT contain any line matching `uncheckedTaskPattern`. Enforces that plans moved into `directory` have all tasks marked done.

forbidUnsafeSymlinks.description: All scanned files and directories MUST NOT be symbolic links, except symlinks within `allowedSymlinkPairs` (root contract symlinks). Catches accidental symlinking that would let harness assets self-leak.

failureMessages.scanRootNotAllowed: symlink scan root is not allowed: {path}
failureMessages.scanEntryNotAllowed: symlink scan entry is not allowed: {path}

seedFiles.description: Optional placeholder files the harness installs but the target repository MAY replace, rename, or remove. Not a check; informational metadata only.

generatedArtifacts.description: Policy for `docs/generated/`. Not a check; informational metadata.
generatedArtifacts.policy: Place actual generated repository artifacts here. Do not add fake placeholder files; keep the directory empty with .gitkeep until a real generation step exists.

harnessEvolution.description: Policy for how the harness evolves. Not a check; informational metadata. The harness is not versioned — the current committed state is the only authoritative shape.
harnessEvolution.policy: The in-repository harness may evolve across discovery, implementation, hardening, release, and maintenance. The current committed harness is the active contract; no schemaVersion, no deprecated keys, no compatibility shims.

teamPatterns.description: Catalog of team/agent collaboration patterns this harness recognises. Not a check; informational metadata.
